articles.title: Evaxion presents new preclinical data for EVX-04, an off-the-shelf therapeutic vaccine for acute myeloid leukemia

articles.summary: COPENHAGEN, Denmark, June 12, 2026 - Evaxion A/S (NASDAQ: EVAX) (“Evaxion”), a clinical-stage TechBio company developing novel vaccines with its pioneering AI-Immunology™ platform, has been awarded the 2026 Prix Galien UK Award for Best digital health solution for AI-Immunology™.
articles.title: Evaxion receives Prix Galien UK Award for Best digital health solution
